narrative.weekly_mirror: Lukas, this week you described staying silent when a joke about “Eastern European work ethic” was made during onboarding, even though it affected Tomasz. That echoes the earlier choice to take “the easier path” so “nobody has to be uncomfortable,” suggesting that avoiding discomfort has remained present in situations where fairness and consideration for others matter to you.
narrative.tension_explanation: The tension is between preserving immediate comfort and speaking up when a comment may diminish or stereotype someone. In the onboarding moment, “Tomasz laughed it off” may have made the situation harder to read, while your own silence still left you noticing that you had not intervened.
narrative.reflective_question: What did you notice in yourself when the joke was made, and what might you want to understand about choosing silence in that moment?
